ai.title: AI adoption by industry shows what other sectors can learn
ai.brief: Tech and finance are setting the pace on AI adoption. TripleTen research shows which skills will reach healthcare, education, and retail next. The current narrative around artificial intelligence in the workplace is largely driven by Silicon Valley. But treating the tech sector as an island misses the actual trends in technology adoption–tech is just the first industry in line. As generative AI and automation tools mature, the shifts currently reshaping software engineering and product management will inevitably filter into healthcare, education, retail, and manufacturing. The variation in adoption rates today isn't a sign that non-tech industries are falling behind, but rather a reflection of the different speeds at which industries absorb new workflows. For leaders and their teams outside of tech, this differential pace provides a practical blueprint for how AI adoption unfolds, and where the opportunities lie.

sec.title: AfD Email Breach Exposes 421,000 Messages in Anonymous Online Archive
sec.brief: S. S. CISA adds Atlassian flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog Germany’s Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) confirmed on October 19 that its hosting provider was hacked in September and that mailboxes were copied. cc had already been online for hours offering an index of what it claims are 421,179 internal party emails.
